description: Replies under a TikTok comment — same authorId/authorSecUid/commentLanguage shape as comments. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

commentId.description: ID of the parent (top-level) comment to fetch replies for — from the comments endpoint. Legacy alias: comment_id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value from the previous response.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 50, max 500). Flat 2 credits per call.

url.description: Public TikTok video or photo-carousel URL, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame/video/7646812028874673439 or https://www.tiktok.com/@user/photo/ID (the url channel-posts returns for mediaType photo). Not a YouTube/Instagram/Facebook URL. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: tiktok_comment_replies
title: TikTok Comment Replies
